name: imagenette_ordering_hierarchy_v1
question: With every view's probability multiset fixed, which class identities should receive the non-target values?

selection.rule: lambda=0 identity-keyed Gumbel Top10 per true class
selection.high_low_split: within each selected true class, top/bottom five by the frozen calibration entropy

templates.image_template: equal mean of 64 conditional non-target distributions
templates.class_template: equal mean of the five current-manifest high-entropy image templates; includes the image itself
templates.stability: compare rankings estimated from template views 0:32 versus 32:64

arms.O: current-image current-view original Soft-1 on high five; Hard on low five
arms.B: current-view sorted non-target spectrum assigned by one fixed image-template ordering; Hard on low five
arms.A: current-view sorted non-target spectrum assigned by one fixed current-manifest class-template ordering; Hard on low five
arms.Aprime: inverse of the current-view permutation that maps O to A; Hard on low five

invariants: true-class probability and total non-target mass
Shannon entropy and order-2 effective class count
EL2N distance to the true one-hot target
maximum probability and top-2 total mass
Teacher prediction correctness, but not the identity of an incorrect argmax

training.student: CoDA released ResNetAP-10 random initialization with channelwise GroupNorm
training.optimizer: SGD lr=0.01 momentum=0.9 weight_decay=0.0005 on all parameters

analysis.fixed_blocks: three Student-seed pairs, each used by three manifests
